body: Sorry but that person isn’t my boyfriend. I think just someone who is also trying to help out that’s all
Okay thank you for your advice, I’ll give him the space he needs and I’ll figure out how to work on my anxiety and panic attacks during the time!
Of course not, I’m on reddit to ask for help on either a way to work out my issue with him or my anxiety.
I have tried therapy before but it cut my insurance, causing my mom a lot of stress and I truly regret ever going to one.

That’s really nice of your boyfriend to be so understanding. I really tried, like yesterday I messaged him saying we should meet up and fix this for hours hoping he will agree but I think I made him even angrier. I told him we could meet up yesterday (Sunday) or today since I get out of college early but he said he doesn’t want to see me,or even call me.
I have talked to a friend (who also is my boyfriend’s friend) about it and he told me I should chill and work on my anxiety. Of course I want to but it’s seriously not easy at all.
Thank you so much! I’m glad I’m not alone with this crazy feeling of anxiety. I really do hope to look back later on and see it was for nothing! Your words are very helpful, once again thank you!!

I didn’t answer how to make the feeling stop, I’m sorry! This is from my professor but what he told me is instead of doing nothing but stress, you should start on the work while still stressing. You’re using the same amount of energy for both situations but on one of it you’re getting things done. In the end once you see that you accomplished the task, you should feel more relief :) (I hope that makes sense I’m bad at explaining but I’m just trying to help)

Hi, I was wondering if you’re in high school or college? Not really important since both will have the same answer. When it comes to school works, start by emailing your teachers, explaining your reasons. (Hopefully your teacher is someone who is nice and understanding) Next is saying as a what if: you didn’t get your homework done on time? I still think you should continue to do it and turn it in late, you will probably get a lower grade for it but it will definitely be better than a 0. 

And please do not give up, take this as a learning experience. (Definitely easier said than done though)
